JUST IN: The Department of Foreign Affairs has lodged a diplomatic protest against China’s plan to establish a new national nature reserve at Scarborough Shoal.

“The Department filed a protest yesterday, which is a strong, unequivocal and formal articulation of the Philippines’ objections to China’s action,” DFA spokesperson Angelica Escalona said.

Beijing has said the conservation area aims to “maintain the diversity, stability and sustainability” of the shoal’s ecosystem. | @TristanNodalo
